lines.engine.need.title: Controller or keyboard required
lines.engine.need.text: This game plays with a controller or a keyboard. Connect one, then press a button.
lines.engine.shell.quit_text: Progress since the last save is lost.
lines.engine.shell.fullscreen_app: Opened from the home screen: no browser bars.
lines.engine.shell.fullscreen_iphone: On an iPhone: Share, then Add to Home Screen, plays without the browser's bars.
lines.engine.shell.fullscreen_blocked: This browser or page doesn't allow it.
lines.engine.controls.how: Choose a key or button, then press the new one. The arrow keys, the d-pad, Enter and Escape always work in menus.
lines.engine.controls.pad_none: No controller found: press a button on one to connect it.
lines.engine.controls.press_pad: Press a controller button for {action} (Start cancels).
lines.engine.controls.press_key: Press a key or mouse button for {action} (Escape cancels).
lines.engine.controls.restored: Every control is back to its default.
lines.engine.controls.reserved: {key} is kept for the menus. Choose another, or press Escape.
lines.engine.controls.taken: {key} is already {action}. Rebind {action} first, or choose another.
lines.engine.calibrate.how: Tap on each click you hear, in time with it, not before ({taps} of 8). The higher click starts each bar.
lines.engine.calibrate.done: Your sound comes {ms} ms after the beat. Keep it, or tap on to measure again.
lines.engine.note.pad_lost_text: Press a button on a controller to use it, or play on.
lines.engine.saves.newer: From a newer version of the game
lines.engine.saves.blocked: Saving is blocked here: these saves last for this visit.
lines.engine.setting.zoom.help: Closer or farther than the game frames it. In play: the mouse wheel, - and =, or a pinch
lines.engine.setting.frame_rate.help: Auto: every refresh while the game keeps up, every other one, evenly, when it can't. 60: every other refresh on a 120 Hz screen. Full: every refresh
lines.engine.setting.show_fps.help: At the top of the screen: frames drawn a second, the screen's refresh and a frame's cost
lines.engine.setting.scale.help: Sharp: every pixel the same size. Fill: the whole screen
lines.engine.setting.filter.help: Scanlines: the dark lines between a TV's rows. CRT: those, its colored stripes and its darker corners
lines.engine.setting.background.help: Keep playing sound while the page is hidden
lines.engine.setting.audio_offset.help: The music this much earlier, for speakers or headphones that lag (wireless ones: 150 to 250). Calibrate: tap on the clicks you hear
lines.engine.setting.motion.help: No screen shake, shorter flashes, still menus
lines.engine.boot.2: Snapping every pixel to the grid
lines.engine.setting.look3d.help: Cards are drawn exactly as in the 2D games; puppets are 3D parts on the same bones, in the scene's light and shadow.
lines.engine.setting.picture3d.help: Pixels: the game's own resolution, chunky and fast. Full: the screen's.
lines.engine.setting.shadows3d.help: Torches and the sun cast real shadows.
lines.engine.setting.filter3d.help: A look over the whole picture: comic-book ink and flat light, or big dithered pixels.
lines.engine.setting.tank3d.help: Up walks forward the way your character faces, down backs away, left and right turn it, whatever the camera does. Off: the stick moves it the way the camera looks.
lines.game.title: Slyrim
lines.tip.2: Sneak at night. People see less in the dark.
lines.tip.3: Hold the shout button longer to use more words.
lines.tip.4: A power attack uses stamina. It staggers the enemy.
lines.tip.5: Block with a shield to stop most of the damage.
lines.tip.6: Steal only when nobody sees you.
lines.tip.7: A dragon soul unlocks one word of a shout.
lines.tip.8: Sleep in a bed to restore health, magicka and stamina.
lines.tip.9: Heavy armour makes noise when you sneak.
lines.tip.10: Mix two ingredients with the same effect to make a potion.
lines.set.crosshair.auto: With a bow or a spell
lines.create.title: Your character
lines.bg.warrior.about: You start with a sword, a shield and hide armour. Blade and Guard are higher.
lines.bg.mage.about: You start with a dagger, robes and Frost Spray. Battle Magic and Heal Magic are higher.
lines.bg.thief.about: You start with a dagger, a bow, leather armour and lock picks. Bow and Sneak are higher.

lines.skill.blade.desc: Hit with swords, axes, maces, daggers and fists.
lines.skill.guard.desc: Block hits and bash with a shield.
lines.skill.smithing.desc: Smelt ore, forge weapons and armour, improve them.
lines.skill.battle.desc: Hurt enemies with Fire Bolt and Frost Spray.
lines.skill.mind.desc: Calm enemies and hide with magic.
lines.skill.sneak.desc: Stay unseen near enemies. Attack them unseen.
lines.skill.theft.desc: Open locks and take from pockets.
lines.skill.alchemy.desc: Mix ingredients into potions and poisons.
lines.perk.blade_training.name: Blade Training
lines.perk.blade_training.desc: Melee attacks do 20% more damage for each rank.
lines.perk.heavy_swing.name: Heavy Swing
lines.perk.heavy_swing.desc: Power attacks use 25% less stamina. They stagger more.
lines.perk.bleeding_edge.name: Bleeding Edge
lines.perk.bleeding_edge.desc: Power attacks make the target bleed for 5 seconds.
lines.perk.execution.name: Execution
lines.perk.execution.desc: A power attack kills an enemy below 20% health.
lines.perk.shield_wall.name: Shield Wall
lines.perk.shield_wall.desc: Blocks stop 20% more damage for each rank.
lines.perk.shield_bash.name: Shield Bash
lines.perk.shield_bash.desc: Bashes stagger longer. They use 30% less stamina.
lines.perk.quick_reflexes.name: Quick Reflexes
lines.perk.quick_reflexes.desc: Time slows when you block just before a power attack hits.
lines.perk.arrow_guard.name: Arrow Guard
lines.perk.arrow_guard.desc: A raised shield stops all arrow damage.
lines.perk.steel_smithing.name: Steel Smithing
lines.perk.steel_smithing.desc: You can forge steel. Steel improves twice as much.
lines.perk.fine_edge.name: Fine Edge
lines.perk.fine_edge.desc: You can improve items one more time.
lines.perk.bronze_work.name: Bronze Work
lines.perk.bronze_work.desc: You can forge Old Bronze items and arrows.
lines.perk.dragon_craft.name: Dragon Craft
lines.perk.dragon_craft.desc: You can forge a Dragonbone sword, bow and shield.
lines.perk.battle_mage.name: Battle Mage
lines.perk.battle_mage.desc: Battle Magic spells cost 15% less for each rank.
lines.perk.searing_fire.name: Searing Fire
lines.perk.searing_fire.desc: Fire Bolt does 25% more damage. The burn lasts 6 seconds.
lines.perk.deep_frost.name: Deep Frost
lines.perk.deep_frost.desc: Frost Spray slows 50%. Targets with no stamina freeze for 1 second.
lines.perk.dual_cast.name: Dual Cast
lines.perk.dual_cast.desc: The same spell in both hands has 2.2 times the power for twice the cost.
lines.perk.mender.name: Mender
lines.perk.mender.desc: Heal Magic spells cost 15% less for each rank.
lines.perk.regeneration.name: Regeneration
lines.perk.respite.name: Respite
lines.perk.second_wind.name: Second Wind
lines.perk.second_wind.desc: Below 10% health, you heal 50% at once. This works once in 10 minutes.
lines.perk.quiet_mind.name: Quiet Mind
lines.perk.quiet_mind.desc: Mind Magic spells cost 20% less for each rank.
lines.perk.silent_casting.name: Silent Casting
lines.perk.master_calm.name: Master of Calm
lines.perk.master_calm.desc: Calm works on enemies 8 levels higher. It lasts 40 seconds.
lines.perk.shadow_walk.name: Shadow Walk
lines.perk.shadow_walk.desc: Hush also makes you invisible for 5 seconds.
lines.perk.bow_training.name: Bow Training
lines.perk.bow_training.desc: Arrows do 20% more damage for each rank.
lines.perk.steady_aim.name: Steady Aim
lines.perk.steady_aim.desc: When you zoom with a bow, time slows. This uses stamina.
lines.perk.quick_draw.name: Quick Draw
lines.perk.ranger.name: Ranger
lines.perk.ranger.desc: You move at full speed with a drawn bow. Arrows stagger.
lines.perk.stealth.name: Stealth
lines.perk.stealth.desc: Enemies notice you 15% less for each rank.
lines.perk.backstab.name: Backstab
lines.perk.backstab.desc: Sneak attacks with daggers do six times the damage.
lines.perk.deadly_aim.name: Deadly Aim
lines.perk.deadly_aim.desc: Sneak attacks with bows do three times the damage.
lines.perk.fade_out.name: Fade Out
lines.perk.fade_out.desc: Sneak in combat to make enemies lose you for 2 seconds. This works once a minute.
lines.perk.light_fingers.name: Light Fingers
lines.perk.light_fingers.desc: Pickpocket chance is 15% higher for each rank.
lines.perk.lock_sense.name: Lock Sense
lines.perk.lock_sense.desc: The sweet spot is 30% wider. Picks break half as often.
lines.perk.quiet_hands.name: Quiet Hands
lines.perk.quiet_hands.desc: A failed pickpocket is not a crime when nobody else sees it.
lines.perk.master_thief.name: Master Thief
lines.perk.master_thief.desc: Picks do not break on easy and average locks. Containers hold 50% more gold.
lines.perk.alchemist.name: Alchemist
lines.perk.alchemist.desc: Potions and poisons are 20% stronger for each rank.
lines.perk.herbalist.name: Herbalist
lines.perk.herbalist.desc: You get two ingredients from each plant.
lines.perk.poisoner.name: Poisoner
lines.perk.poisoner.desc: A poison on a weapon lasts for 3 hits.
lines.perk.purity.name: Purity
lines.perk.purity.desc: Potions lose harmful effects. Poisons lose helpful effects.
lines.spell.fire_bolt.name: Fire Bolt
lines.spell.fire_bolt.desc: A bolt of fire. It does 18 damage and burns. It lights braziers and torches.
lines.spell.frost_spray.name: Frost Spray
lines.spell.frost_spray.desc: A cold spray in front of you. It does damage, drains stamina and slows the target.
lines.spell.heal.name: Heal
lines.spell.heal.desc: Heals 12 health each second while you hold it.
lines.spell.calm.name: Calm
lines.spell.calm.desc: A target up to level 6 stops the fight for 20 seconds.
lines.spell.hush.name: Hush
lines.spell.hush.desc: For 30 seconds your footsteps make no sound. Enemies notice you less.
lines.shout.push.name: Push
lines.shout.push.desc: A wave of force in front of you. More words push harder.
lines.shout.rush.name: Rush
lines.shout.rush.desc: You move forward very fast, through enemies.
lines.shout.lure.name: Lure
lines.shout.lure.desc: Your voice comes from the point you aim at. Enemies near that point go there.
lines.item.iron_dagger.name: Iron Dagger
lines.item.iron_dagger.desc: A short iron blade. It is fast. It is good for sneak attacks.
lines.item.iron_sword.name: Iron Sword
lines.item.iron_sword.desc: A plain iron sword. It is a good first weapon.
lines.item.iron_axe.name: Iron Axe
lines.item.iron_axe.desc: An iron war axe. It hits harder than a sword.
lines.item.iron_mace.name: Iron Mace
lines.item.iron_mace.desc: An iron mace. It is slow. It hits hard.
lines.item.iron_greatsword.name: Iron Greatsword
lines.item.iron_greatsword.desc: A long iron sword for two hands. It is slow and strong.
lines.item.steel_sword.name: Steel Sword
lines.item.steel_sword.desc: A steel sword. The edge holds well.
lines.item.steel_axe.name: Steel Axe
lines.item.steel_axe.desc: A steel war axe from a good forge.
lines.item.steel_greatsword.name: Steel Greatsword
lines.item.steel_greatsword.desc: A long steel sword for two hands.
lines.item.bronze_sword.name: Old Bronze Sword

lines.item.bronze_greatsword.name: Old Bronze Greatsword
lines.item.bronze_greatsword.desc: A great sword from the barrow. It is heavy and old. It is still strong.
lines.item.bjarke_hammer.name: Bjarke's Hammer
lines.item.bjarke_hammer.desc: Bjarke's own hammer. It is a good mace.
lines.item.dragonbone_sword.name: Dragonbone Sword

lines.item.leather_boots.name: Leather Boots

lines.item.dragonbone_shield.name: Dragonbone Shield
lines.item.dragonbone_shield.desc: A shield of dragon bone and scales. It blocks very well.
lines.item.wool_robes.name: Wool Robes

lines.item.book_herbs.desc: A book about plants. Read it to learn more about Alchemy.

lines.item.tome_frost.desc: Read it to learn the spell Frost Spray.

lines.dlg.c.rent: I want a room for the night. (10 gold)
lines.dlg.c.bark_dragon: A dragon flew over the valley. I saw it.
lines.dlg.holger.hello: You came out of the fire alive. I will not forget that. Come and see my goods.
lines.dlg.holger.mq1: Pinewater is to the west. Walk with me.
lines.dlg.holger.road: The road is cold. Pinewater is to the west. We will be there before noon.
lines.dlg.holger.attack: A dragon. Run to the trees. Get down.
lines.dlg.holger.bark1: The roads are dangerous now. Keep your weapon ready.
lines.dlg.gyda.news1: You came on the east road. A dragon burned the carts.
lines.dlg.gyda.news2: Go to Greystead. Tell the Reeve. Give her the letter from the east.
lines.dlg.gyda.hello: Welcome to the Pine Hearth. The fire is warm and the stew is hot.
lines.dlg.gyda.rented: The room is yours for one day. The beds are at the back.
lines.dlg.gyda.no_gold: You do not have enough gold.
lines.dlg.gyda.rumor: Eskil at the mill has trouble with wolves. Talk to him.
lines.dlg.gyda.bark1: Sit by the fire. You look cold.
lines.dlg.gyda.bark2: I buy firewood. Bring me some.
lines.dlg.bjarke.hello: The forge is hot. What do you need?
lines.dlg.bjarke.hammer1: I lost my old hammer in Silvervein Mine. Frost spiders came, and I ran.
lines.dlg.bjarke.hammer2: Find the hammer. Then mine two iron ore. Smelt the ore, make a dagger and improve it. I will teach you the forge.
lines.dlg.bjarke.teach1: Use the smelter to make iron bars from the ore. Use the anvil to make a dagger.
lines.dlg.bjarke.teach2: Then use the workbench. It makes the dagger better.
lines.dlg.bjarke.thanks: This is my old hammer. Take my best hammer. It is a good mace. I will sell to you for less now.
lines.dlg.bjarke.c_how: How do I use the forge?
lines.dlg.bjarke.bark1: Good iron makes a good blade.
lines.dlg.oddny.hello: This is Oddny's Goods. I sell potions, herbs and tools.
lines.dlg.oddny.fever1: Maren on the farm has a cold fever. A Potion of Resist Frost will help her.
lines.dlg.oddny.fever2: Find Frostberry and Snow Lily. Mix the two at an alchemy table. Then give the potion to Maren.
lines.dlg.oddny.how: Put the two ingredients on the alchemy table. They share the effect Resist Frost.
lines.dlg.oddny.c_how: How do I make the potion?
lines.dlg.oddny.bark2: A potion can save your life on the road.
lines.dlg.eskil.hello: The mill turns all day. Wolves come at night.
lines.dlg.eskil.wolves1: Three wolves live near the mill. They killed my goats.
lines.dlg.eskil.wolves2: Kill the wolves. I will pay you sixty gold.
lines.dlg.eskil.paid: Thank you. The wolves will not come back. Here is your gold.
lines.dlg.eskil.bark1: The river is cold this year.
lines.dlg.eskil.bark2: Do not walk to the mill at night.
lines.dlg.maren.hello: This is my farm. I sell cabbages and potatoes.
lines.dlg.maren.sick: I am cold all the time. Oddny makes potions. Ask her for help.
lines.dlg.maren.better: I feel warm again. Thank you. Take these herbs and this gold.
lines.dlg.maren.c_potion: I have a Potion of Resist Frost for you.
lines.dlg.maren.bark1: The soil is hard and cold.
lines.dlg.arne.hello: I watch the gate of Pinewater. The roads are not safe.
lines.dlg.arne.law: Do not steal and do not attack people. If you do, you must pay a fine.
lines.dlg.arne.bark2: I watch the gate. Move along.
lines.dlg.asbjorn.hello: I hunt in these woods. I buy hides and I sell arrows.
lines.dlg.asbjorn.lesson1: Kill a deer with a bow. Then take the hide from the body.
lines.dlg.asbjorn.lesson2: Use the tanning rack in Pinewater. Bring me the leather.
lines.dlg.asbjorn.good: This is good leather. Take this bow and these arrows.
lines.dlg.asbjorn.giant1: A giant lives at Big Stone Camp. It kills the game in my woods.
lines.dlg.asbjorn.giant2: Kill the giant. Or use the Calm spell on it and take its chest. Then come back to me.
lines.dlg.asbjorn.paid: The woods are quiet now. Here is your gold.
lines.dlg.asbjorn.c_giant: Do you have work for me?
lines.dlg.asbjorn.c_giant_done: I went to Big Stone Camp.
lines.dlg.asbjorn.bark1: The deer run fast in the snow.
lines.dlg.ylva.hello: I am Ylva, the Reeve of Greystead. Speak.
lines.dlg.ylva.letter1: This letter says that dragons attack the east. Now a dragon is here.
lines.dlg.ylva.letter2: Talk to Eyvind. He reads the old texts.
lines.dlg.ylva.mq4_1: Captain Leif told me. You killed the dragon and took its voice.
lines.dlg.ylva.mq4_2: Greystead thanks you. Take this gold and this weapon.
lines.dlg.ylva.mq6_1: Jarnorm is dead. The dragons have no call now.
lines.dlg.ylva.mq6_2: Take this ring and this gold. You are a Friend of Greystead.
lines.dlg.ylva.dragons: The dragons came back after a long time. We must find out why.
lines.dlg.ylva.c_letter: I have a letter from the east.
lines.dlg.ylva.c_dragons: What do you know about the dragons?
lines.dlg.eyvind.hello: I read the old texts. I also sell spell tomes.
lines.dlg.eyvind.barrow1: The old texts tell of a Voice Stone in Ravenmound Barrow.
lines.dlg.eyvind.barrow2: Go to the barrow. Make a copy of the runes. Bring the copy to me.
lines.dlg.eyvind.runes1: These runes are a word of the Old Voice. You can read the word. You cannot use it.
lines.dlg.eyvind.runes2: A person must take the voice of a dead dragon first. The old texts say this.
lines.dlg.eyvind.lore: The Elders live in the Hall of Echoes on Greytooth Peak. They know the Old Voice.
lines.dlg.eyvind.c_runes: Here is the copy of the runes.
lines.dlg.eyvind.bark1: The old texts have many answers.
lines.dlg.leif.hello: I am Captain Leif. I keep the law in Greystead.
lines.dlg.leif.run_in: A dragon attacks North Watch. Come with me. Bring your bow.
lines.dlg.leif.after1: The light from the dragon went into you. The old stories tell of this.
lines.dlg.leif.after2: Go to the Reeve. Tell her what happened here.
lines.dlg.leif.bounty1: Raiders hold Fort Ashgrip. Their chief is Hrolf.
lines.dlg.leif.bounty2: Kill Hrolf. Then come back to me. The pay is three hundred gold.
lines.dlg.leif.paid: Hrolf is dead. The east road is safer now. Here is your pay.
lines.dlg.leif.c_bounty: Do you have work for me?
lines.dlg.gunnar.hello: I am the steward. I keep the accounts of Greystead.
lines.dlg.gunnar.ledger: My ledger is in my house. It is not your business.
lines.dlg.gunnar.c_ledger: What do you keep in your house?
lines.dlg.knut.hello: Speak quietly. What do you want?
lines.dlg.knut.ledger1: The steward keeps a ledger in his house. I want it.
lines.dlg.knut.ledger2: Take the key from him, or open the lock. Do not let anyone see you.
lines.dlg.knut.paid: Good work. Take this gold and this ring. Bring me other goods. I buy them and I ask no questions.
lines.dlg.knut.c_work: Do you have work for me?
lines.dlg.knut.bark1: I did not see you. You did not see me.
lines.dlg.sigrun.hello: I am Sigrun. My sword is for hire.
lines.dlg.sigrun.terms: Pay me two hundred gold. Or win a fist fight against me. Then I follow you.
lines.dlg.sigrun.hired: Good. I follow you now. Tell me when to wait.
lines.dlg.sigrun.brawl: Fists only. We stop when one of us falls.
lines.dlg.sigrun.no_gold: You do not have two hundred gold.
lines.dlg.sigrun.mine: I am here. What do you need?
lines.dlg.sigrun.part: Then we part here. Find me at the Antler Inn.
lines.dlg.sigrun.c_pay: I will pay two hundred gold.
lines.dlg.sigrun.c_pack: Let me see what you carry.
lines.dlg.sigrun_won.won: You hit hard. I keep my word. I follow you now.
lines.dlg.sigrun_lost.lost: You lost. Pay two hundred gold, or come back and fight again.
lines.dlg.asa.hello: Welcome to the Antler Inn. Sit by the fire.
lines.dlg.asa.rented: The room is yours for one day. The beds are upstairs.
lines.dlg.asa.no_gold: You do not have enough gold.
lines.dlg.asa.rumor: Captain Leif has a bounty on the raiders at Fort Ashgrip.
lines.dlg.tove.hello: I sell goods from all of Hrimdal.
lines.dlg.solvi.hello: I am Solvi. I play songs in the evening.
lines.dlg.solvi.c_song1: Play the song of the road.
lines.dlg.solvi.c_song2: Play the song of the dragons.
lines.dlg.solvi.bark1: A song makes the night short.
lines.dlg.halvar.hello: This is the Hall of Echoes. Speak quietly here.
lines.dlg.halvar.teach1: You used the voice of a dragon. We can teach you two words. Listen. Then shout.
lines.dlg.halvar.teach2: Ingrid and Tormod will test you in the courtyard. Show them Push and Rush.
lines.dlg.halvar.jarnorm1: Jarnorm is the oldest dragon. It sleeps on Skyfang Peak.
lines.dlg.halvar.jarnorm2: Its call wakes the other dragons. Kill Jarnorm.
lines.dlg.halvar.jarnorm3: The Old Anchors stand on the peak. They can hold a dragon on the ground.
lines.dlg.halvar.bark1: The Old Voice is not a weapon for anger.
lines.dlg.ingrid.hello: The Old Voice is strong. Use it with care.
lines.dlg.ingrid.push: Shout Push at the three stone targets. Knock all three down.
lines.dlg.tormod.hello: The mountain is cold. Stay near the fire.
lines.dlg.tormod.rush: The gate opens for a short time. Shout Rush to go through before it closes.
lines.dlg.tormod.bark1: Be fast. The gate does not wait.
lines.dlg.guard.law: Theft and attacks bring a bounty. Pay the fine, or go to jail.
lines.dlg.guard.watch: The road to North Watch is not safe. Raiders are near Fort Ashgrip.
lines.dlg.guard.c_law: What happens if I break the law?
lines.dlg.guard.bark1: The road to North Watch is not safe.
lines.dlg.guard.bark2: Keep your weapon away in town.
lines.dlg.guard.bark_mq4: You took the voice of a dragon. People talk about it.
lines.dlg.arrest.stop: Stop. You broke the law. The fine is {fine} gold.
lines.dlg.arrest.paid: Good. You paid the fine. Do not break the law again.
lines.dlg.arrest.no_gold: You do not have enough gold.
lines.quest.mq1.title: The Old Road
lines.quest.mq1.s30: Take a weapon from the cart.
lines.quest.mq1.s50: Touch one of the Three Stones.
lines.quest.mq2.title: News of the Dragon
lines.quest.mq2.s10: Talk to Gyda in the Pine Hearth.
lines.quest.mq2.s20: Take the letter to the Reeve in Greystead.
lines.quest.mq2.s30: Talk to Eyvind in the Long Hall.
lines.quest.mq3.title: Ravenmound
lines.quest.mq3.s30: Open the gate in the brazier room.
lines.quest.mq3.s60: Take the copy of the runes to Eyvind.
lines.quest.mq4.title: Dragon at North Watch
lines.quest.mq4.s10: Go to North Watch with Captain Leif.
lines.quest.mq4.s30: Go to the body of the dragon.
lines.quest.mq5.title: The Hall of Echoes
lines.quest.mq5.s10: Climb Greytooth Peak to the Hall of Echoes.
lines.quest.mq5.s30: Use the Push shout on the three targets.
lines.quest.mq5.s40: Use the Rush shout to pass the gate.
lines.quest.mq6.title: Skyfang
lines.quest.mq6.s20: Use the Old Anchors to hold Jarnorm on the ground.
lines.quest.mq6.s40: Go to the body of Jarnorm.
lines.quest.sq01.title: Wolves at the Mill
lines.quest.sq01.s10: Kill the three wolves near the mill.
lines.quest.sq02.title: The Lost Hammer
lines.quest.sq02.s10: Find the hammer in Silvervein Mine.
lines.quest.sq03.title: A Cold Fever
lines.quest.sq03.s20: Make a Potion of Resist Frost.
lines.quest.sq04.title: The Steward's Ledger
lines.quest.sq04.s10: Get the key from Steward Gunnar, or open the lock.
lines.quest.sq04.s20: Take the ledger from the chest in the Steward's House. Do not let anyone see you.
lines.quest.sq05.title: The Ashgrip Bounty
lines.quest.sq06.title: The Giant at Big Stone
lines.quest.sq06.s20: Kill the giant, or use Calm and take the chest.
lines.quest.sq07.title: A Sword for Hire
lines.quest.sq07.s10: Pay 200 gold, or win a fist fight against Sigrun.
lines.quest.sq08.title: The Hunter's Lesson
lines.quest.sq08.s10: Kill a deer with a bow.
lines.tut.move.title: Move
lines.tut.move: Use {key:up} {key:left} {key:down} {key:right} or the left stick to move. Move the mouse or the right stick to look.
lines.tut.sprint.title: Sprint
lines.tut.sprint: Hold {key:sprint} to sprint. A sprint uses stamina.
lines.tut.sneak.title: Sneak
lines.tut.sneak: Press {key:sneak} to sneak. Enemies see you less when you sneak.
lines.tut.interact.title: Use
lines.tut.interact: Press {key:interact} to use the thing in front of you.
lines.tut.equip.title: Equip
lines.tut.equip: Press {key:hub} to open the menu. Choose Items. Select a weapon to equip it.
lines.tut.attack.title: Attack
lines.tut.attack: Press {key:attack} to attack with your right hand.
lines.tut.block.title: Block
lines.tut.block: Hold {key:block} to block with a shield or a weapon. A block takes less damage.
lines.tut.power.title: Power attack
lines.tut.power: Hold {key:attack} to do a power attack. A power attack uses stamina.
lines.tut.heal.title: Heal
lines.tut.heal: Your health is low. Cast Heal, or drink a Potion of Health from the Items menu.
lines.tut.stones.title: The Three Stones
lines.tut.stones: Touch one stone to get its blessing. You can have one blessing at a time.
lines.tut.menu.title: The menu
lines.tut.menu: Press {key:hub} to open the menu. It has Items, Magic, Skills, Map, Quests and Character.
lines.tut.shout.title: Shout
lines.tut.shout: Hold {key:shout} to shout. Hold it longer to use more words.
lines.tut.shout_words.title: Words
lines.tut.shout_words: Tap {key:shout} for one word. Hold it for two words. Hold it longer for three words.
lines.note.anchor_broke: Jarnorm broke one of the Old Anchors.
lines.note.anchor_far: The dragon is too far away.
lines.note.brawl: A fist fight. Use your fists only.
lines.note.brazier_how: Light the brazier with fire. Use Fire Bolt or a torch.
lines.note.brazier_wrong: The fire went out. Darts came from the walls.
lines.note.ice_cracks: Danger: the ice cracks under the dragon.
lines.note.jarnorm_angry: Jarnorm is angry. It moves faster now.
lines.note.mountain_call: A voice comes from the mountain. It says one word.
lines.note.rent_first: This bed is not yours. Rent a room from the innkeeper.
lines.note.room_rented: You rented a room for one day.
lines.note.storm: A snowstorm comes. You can see less.
lines.note.word_needs_soul: Use a dragon soul in the Magic menu to unlock the new word.
lines.board.empty: No notices are on the board.
lines.board.wolves: Wolves at the Pinewater mill. Eskil the miller pays sixty gold. Talk to him.
lines.board.ashgrip: Raiders hold Fort Ashgrip. Kill their chief, Hrolf. Captain Leif pays three hundred gold.
lines.demo.title: Demo complete
lines.demo.text: You killed Jarnorm. Hrimdal is free of its call. You can go on and explore.
lines.book.book_old_voice.p1: A Voice Stone has words of the Old Voice. The words are cut in runes. You can read a word. You cannot use the word.
lines.book.book_old_voice.p2: A person must take the voice of a dead dragon first. Then the word is free. Then the person can shout the word.
lines.book.book_old_voice.p3: A shout has up to three words. One word is weak. Three words are strong. After a shout, you must wait before you shout again.
lines.book.book_dragons_north.p1: Long ago, dragons ruled the north. People hid in barrows and in the mountains.
lines.book.book_dragons_north.p2: The people made the Old Anchors on Skyfang Peak. The anchors held the dragons on the ground. Then the warriors killed them.
lines.book.book_dragons_north.p3: Jarnorm was the oldest dragon. The warriors could not kill it. It went to sleep on Skyfang Peak.
lines.book.book_dragons_north.p4: The old texts say this: when Jarnorm wakes, its call wakes the other dragons.
lines.book.book_barrow_notes.p1: Day one. I found the barrow. The dead lie in coffins in the walls. Some of them move.
lines.book.book_barrow_notes.p2: Day two. Do not step on the stone plates. Arrows come from the walls. Sneak, and look at the floor.
lines.book.book_barrow_notes.p3: Day three. Four braziers stand by the gate. The carvings show the order: Owl, Raven, Bear, Fox.
lines.book.book_three_stones.p1: Three stones stand on the Old Road west of Eastgate Pass. Each stone gives one blessing.
lines.book.book_three_stones.p2: The Bear gives strength: you can carry more and you hit harder. The Owl gives magic: magicka comes back faster.
lines.book.book_three_stones.p3: The Fox gives skill: you sneak and steal better. You can have one blessing at a time. Touch another stone to change it.
lines.book.book_locks.p1: A lock has a sweet spot. The pick finds it. The lock turns only at the sweet spot.
lines.book.book_locks.p2: Move the pick a little. Turn the lock. If the lock stops, the pick is in the wrong place.
lines.book.book_locks.p3: Do not turn the lock for a long time at the wrong place. The pick will break. Keep the pick still and try again.
lines.book.book_smith.p1: Mine ore with a pickaxe. Iron ore is common. Silver ore is rare.
lines.book.book_smith.p2: Put the ore in the smelter. The smelter makes bars. Cut leather into strips at the tanning rack.
lines.book.book_smith.p3: Use the anvil to make weapons and armour. Use the workbench to make them better.
lines.book.book_herbs.p1: Frostberry grows in the snow. It restores stamina. Snow Lily grows near water. It resists frost.
lines.book.book_herbs.p2: Bog Cap grows near the lake. It damages health. Troll Fat restores health.
lines.book.book_herbs.p3: Mix two ingredients with the same effect at an alchemy table. The table makes a potion or a poison.
lines.book.book_archer.p1: Draw the bow fully. A full draw shoots far and hits hard.
lines.book.book_archer.p2: Breathe out before you release. Aim at the head. A hit to the head does more damage.
lines.book.book_archer.p3: Sneak before you shoot. An enemy that does not see you takes more damage.
lines.book.book_law.p1: The Reeve of Greystead keeps the law in all of Hrimdal. The guards obey the Reeve.
lines.book.book_law.p2: Theft, attacks and murder are crimes. Each crime adds to your bounty.
lines.book.book_law.p3: A guard will stop you. Pay the fine, or go to jail. If you resist, the guards attack you.

notes.round.progress: Shown on the 52in1 scoreboard during a round.
notes.tip.1: A loading tip on the boot screen.

brief:
Slyrim is an open-world fantasy action RPG set in Hrimdal, a cold valley in the far north. The player is a courier who learns to shout with the voice of dragons and kills the old dragon Jarnorm. Every line uses a plain, technical style (ASD-STE100): short active sentences, plain words, no jokes, puns, idioms or dramatic flair. Keep that plain style in the translation. The title 'Slyrim' joins the English word 'sly' with the name of the game that inspired it; keep the title as written. The player character's body type is the player's choice; lines address the player as 'you' and never depend on gender. Use one form of 'you' for the player; people in the valley speak directly and politely. VAR, KOLT, BRASK, SKARD, ELM and HVIS are words of an invented dragon language: do not translate them.

Lines with ids starting engine. are the engine's own words: its pause menu, settings, controls screen, save slots, notices and key names. Keep them short: they sit on buttons and in narrow rows. Lines with ids starting dev. are developer text and are not translated.
